changes.newValue: Fixed: SCROLL_SPEED reduced 120→75, slowdown_range widened 120→180px. This gives 38% slower scrolling and longer slow zones near ore deposits.

snapshot.title: UX: Mining map scroll speed makes ore targets difficult to hit
snapshot.description: The mining side-scroll map has variable/random speed intervals that make it very hard to position the mining beam on target ores. Combined with limited time, mission goals feel unattainable. Speed should feel controllable and fair.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Scroll speed is consistent or player has some control over timing
Target ore appears on screen long enough to mine it realistically
Mission completion is achievable on a first or second attempt for new players
